operatorConstraint: no synthetic parts, must be real parts taken from real reputable sources
purpose: Manifest of reputable external real-CAD sources needed to push the unified CAM-training corpus past 100,000 unique real-data entries.

sources.name: ABC: A Big CAD Model Dataset For Geometric Deep Learning
sources.paper: Koch et al., CVPR 2019 — "ABC: A Big CAD Model Dataset For Geometric Deep Learning"
sources.citation: @inproceedings{Koch_2019_CVPR, author={Koch, Sebastian and Matveev, Albert and Jiang, Zhongshi and Williams, Francis and Artemov, Alexey and Burnaev, Evgeny and Alexa, Marc and Zorin, Denis and Panozzo, Daniele}, title={ABC: A Big CAD Model Dataset for Geometric Deep Learning}, booktitle={CVPR}, year={2019}}
sources.provenance: Public user-uploaded designs from Onshape (real engineers, real parts).
sources.notes: Smallest-bytes-first subset for the 100k target. Each .7z chunk extracts to ~10k STEP files. Acquisition is OUT-OF-BAND (does not run inside a /loop tick) — scripts/acquire-abc-dataset.mjs builds the resumable download list; operator runs it on a downloader machine and copies the extracted STEPs to H:/datasets/abc/.

sources.name: Fusion 360 Gallery Dataset
sources.paper: Willis et al., "Fusion 360 Gallery: A Dataset and Environment for Programmatic CAD Reconstruction"
sources.provenance: Real Fusion 360 designs from the public Autodesk Online Gallery, filtered + cleaned by Autodesk Research.

Segmentation.purpose: B-Rep face segmentation by machining operation

sources.notes: Highest-value source for CAM training: Segmentation subset labels every B-Rep face with a machining operation type — this IS the training-signal Phase B needs for template generation.

sources.name: Mechanical Components Benchmark (Purdue)
sources.paper: Kim et al., ECCV 2020 — "A Large-scale Annotated Mechanical Components Benchmark for Classification and Retrieval Tasks with Deep Neural Networks"
sources.provenance: Real mechanical-component CAD models from public manufacturer catalogs, classified into 68 mechanical-component categories.
sources.notes: Pre-classified by component type (bearing, gear, bolt, nut, washer, …). Useful for the template-generator's per-component-type Phase B work.

sources.name: MFCAD++: Machining Feature Recognition Benchmark
sources.paper: Cao et al., "Hierarchical CADNet: Learning from B-Rep Data for Manufacturing Feature Recognition"
sources.provenance: Real machined parts with B-Rep face-level annotations for 24 machining feature classes (hole, pocket, slot, chamfer, fillet, step, blind-slot, blind-hole, …).
sources.notes: B-Rep machining-feature ground truth. Critical for U-CAMT-B01 CAMOperationTaxonomyEngine validation.

sources.name: NIST STEP File Analyzer Test Files
sources.provenance: US Government public-domain STEP test parts curated by NIST for STEP/AP203/AP214/AP242 conformance testing.
sources.notes: Small but high-confidence sanity-check corpus — every STEP analyzer in the world is tested against these.

sources.name: GrabCAD Public CC-Licensed Subset
sources.provenance: Real engineering CAD models uploaded by GrabCAD community members; only the CC-BY-licensed subset is admitted to the corpus.
sources.notes: Requires per-file license check at download time — GrabCAD members can choose CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC, or copyright. Ledger admits only the CC-BY subset.

sources.name: TraceParts Public Catalog
sources.provenance: Real vendor-supplied component catalog (millions of standard parts: bolts, screws, washers, fasteners, bearings, gears, structural shapes). Vendor terms allow download + AI-training use for the public-catalog subset.
sources.notes: Vendor real parts complement the engineering-job mix from JM Die + ABC + Fusion 360 Gallery — gives the corpus standard-component coverage.

acquisitionDiscipline.noSyntheticData: Every file MUST trace to one of the 8 reputable archives via CorpusProvenanceLedgerEngine. synthetic=true is HARD-rejected.
acquisitionDiscipline.perFileSha256: Every file gets a SHA-256 hash registered before downstream training consumers see it.
acquisitionDiscipline.licenseAudit: Every license must be on KNOWN_LICENSES allowlist. Source files w/ ambiguous license are quarantined, not silently dropped.
acquisitionDiscipline.restartability: Acquisition scripts are resumable (chunked downloads + checkpoint files) so a 24h fetch survives reboots, network blips, AV scan locks.
acquisitionDiscipline.outOfBandFetch: Actual bytes-over-wire happens out-of-band (cron-able acquisition scripts, not inside /loop ticks). Loop ticks build the manifests + provenance ledger + validation gates.
